title: Applications
content:
1. Determination of the wavelength of a monochromatic light source.

2. Testing the flatness of optical surfaces and the quality of optical components.

3. Measurement of the radius of curvature of a lens, if the wavelength of light is already known.

4. Measurement of the refractive index of a liquid, by filling the air gap between the lens and plate with the liquid and comparing ring diameters before and after.

5. Serves as the conceptual basis for interferometric thickness-measurement and quality-control methods used in optics manufacturing.
